Ivy (CS): Heads-up: ClearPath's account is at 68% of monthly credits but their usage curve is steep; renewal review in 7 days. They flagged sudden increase in chat session lengths after enabling conversation-history.
Diego (AE): Do they have long context windows or just more sessions?
Ivy (CS): Both. Long context in support chat (avg tokens/session up 2.2x) plus an automated summarizer that's running frequently.
Bri (Solutions Eng): Quick mitigation: introduce context window capping (e.g., last 2048 tokens) + summary-on-save instead of real-time summaries. Also enable KV cache for repeated conversation fragments.
LedgerBot: alert: account_usage.clearpath > 65% (triggered at 2841023460).
Nora (Finance): If they stay high it's a renewal risk. Could offer a mid-cycle commit to lock tier but need projected savings to justify.
Diego (AE): Customer prefers product continuity. Any non-invasive suggestions?
Bri (Solutions Eng): Yes, sampling strategy: keep full context for escalations only; otherwise trim oldest messages beyond N messages. Example policy snippet:
```json
{"policy_name":"clearpath-context-trim","route":"/v1/chat","retain_last_messages":30,"max_tokens":2048,"exclusions":["escalation_flag"]}
```
Ivy (CS): I'll schedule a short runbook review with their platform team tomorrow 9am PT. We'll also surface this as a QBR talking point with the usage curve and our proposed fixes.
Diego (AE): I'll prepare a one-pager with before/after token projections and a suggested 6mo commit level.
Nora (Finance): I'll compute commit scenarios. Use conservative 20% savings for cache+capping, 35% if they adopt async summarizer + KV cache.
Bri (Solutions Eng): We should propose a temporary 'usage egress window' where expensive summarizers run off-peak. That reduces peak pressure.
Ivy (CS): Add product feedback: requesting a per-run summary cost estimate in Console. I'll file the feedback with ProductOps.
Diego (AE): Action items: Diego - one-pager; Ivy - runbook & feedback; Bri - policy PR and cost estimates; Nora - scenario pricing.
LedgerBot: ticket CS-8700 opened for ClearPath cost mitigation.
Ivy (CS): I'll post the session notes and graphs here after the call.
